title: Taps on iPhone: the price buttons answer every tap
problem: On iPhone Safari the pricing sheet's buttons feel slow and sometimes miss a tap. Safari ignores the page's no-zoom setting and its unprefixed user-select, so a quick second tap is taken as a double tap (a zoom, or selecting the button's own sign) and no press is sent; the − and + also show no pressed look. A tap itself is cheap (about 20 ms with the processor slowed 4x), so the game's own work is not the cause.
scope: Say on the whole page that a double tap is not a zoom (touch-action: manipulation), and on the − and + and Ring the bell themselves
Stop text being selected on iPhone (Safari's -webkit-user-select and no long-press call-out); boxes you type in stay selectable
A pressed look for the − and + of the prices and of the crate, and for Ring the bell, the moment a finger lands
exclusions: No change to the rules, the computer players, the online messages or saves
Not published: the preview and the live game change only on the owner's word
